Who we are

Nexus Driver Solutions LLC, 30 North Gould Street Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA.

What we collect

Information you submit in our forms: name, phone, email, location, driving experience and job preferences (drivers), or company and contact details (carriers). We also collect basic analytics data such as pages visited and device type.

How we use it

To contact you about driving jobs or recruiting services, to match drivers with carriers, and to improve this website. When you apply for a specific job, we share your application details with that carrier so they can review it.

Calls and texts

If you consent, we may call and text you. See our SMS Terms. Mobile numbers and SMS consent are not sold or shared with third parties for their marketing.

Cookies and analytics

We may use Google Analytics and the Meta Pixel to understand site traffic and measure our ads.

Your choices

You can ask us to update or delete your information by contacting us through this website.
